_doc: F7 boss scripted block animations (P1 Maxor, P2 Storm, P4 Necron) from Better PF recordings. frames: [dt, x, y, z, state], dt = server ticks (st/n) after the chat line in 'event' (negative = before), sorted by dt; within one dt apply in array order (file order). Generated 2026-10-03 by /home/cam/.claude/jobs/fffcf85d/tmp/p124anim/build.js from 8 runs of 2026-10-01 (all with chat n).

p1strip.event: [BOSS] Maxor: WELL! WELL! WELL! LOOK WHO'S HERE!
p1strip.consistency: Conveyor: the whole pattern shifts +1 x every 10 server ticks (first update dt 9, last when Maxor dies, ~110 ticks before Storm's first line; 40-59 updates). Updates 1..39 identical (positions+states) in 8/8 recent runs at the same dt (+-1 tick). Update 0 (dt 9) is complete (230 changes) in 3/8 runs incl. this one, partial (93/180) in the others. Also includes the beacon column at (73,221-226,73): glass/stained glass/carpet/beacon/bedrock changes at the same dt in every run. Frames end at Maxor's death; for a longer fight keep shifting (see p1stripRule).

p1stripRule._doc: Per row (y,z), state(x, update k) = state(x-1, update k-1). Rows: y224 z70-76 (gray_wool/cyan_terracotta chevrons, z73 has a gap x~74-79), y225 z72-74 and y226 z72-74 (coal_block/player_head/air items). Content entering at x34 is not derivable; recorded frames cover 40-59 updates.

p1stripStart._doc: State just before update 0, for every strip position that ever changes (1021) + the beacon column (73,221-226,73, library state). 898 positions derived exactly by back-shifting the conveyor one step (verified: the changes of a complete update 0 equal exactly the diff of this state vs frame 0, 229/229, in 3 runs). 123 positions at the exit end (x>=106) and y226 z72-73 x>=78 cannot be derived by shifting and use a heuristic (y224: opposite colour of their first recorded value; y225/226: air if their first value is an item, otherwise library state). Positions in the box that never change keep the library state.

p1end.event: [BOSS] Storm: Pathetic Maxor, just like expected.
p1end.chance: A 6th frame element is the chance the frame happens (rolled per fight). The platforms crumble at random: of their 1174 blocks that go in >=10% of 101 runs (2026-10-01..04), 552 go in >=95%, the rest in 50-70% (per run 63% of them, median), a different set each fight. tools/p3sim/research/scripts/world_p1end.mjs, research/world.md.
p1end.consistency: Burst starts 22-24 ticks before Storm's first line in 8/8 runs (-23 in 6); Maxor's last line varies ("I'M TOO YOUNG TO DIE AGAIN!" is missing in half the runs, and is 1-45 ticks before the burst when present), so Storm's line is the reference. 92-94% of (pos,state) changes match the representative run with dt within +-2 ticks; frames kept only if the same (pos,state) appears in >=5/8 runs (2678 kept of 2820). dt -24: both crystal platforms (x46-64 / x82-100, y215-224) + the y220 centre floor go to air at once; dt -18..-6: the centre hole x68-78 z32-49 'falling' animation (blocks re-appear one layer lower, then turn to air, y219->212). No falling_block entities are spawned (0 in all runs): it is all block changes. 1931 frames are in the centre-hole box.

p2floor.event: [BOSS] Storm: Pathetic Maxor, just like expected.
p2floor.consistency: NOT reproduced: after Storm's line only 4-23 blocks change at y220 (46-185 ticks in), placed one by one along a line at different spots per run (e.g. z41 x86->74 in one run, x73-75 z44-51 in another). No run shows the whole centre floor being refilled, so there is nothing scripted to replay; leave the hole open (or close it instantly if gameplay needs it).

p1lamps.event: [BOSS] Maxor: WELL! WELL! WELL! LOOK WHO'S HERE!
p1lamps._doc: 16 lamps in a T: row z64 x68-78 (west half x68-72, centre x73, east half x74-78) + column x73 z65-69 towards Maxor. Driven by the crystal chat lines, NOT by fixed time: (1) '<n>/2 Energy Crystals are now active!' -> 17-18 ticks later the placing side's half lights (sea_lantern), from the outer end inward, ~1 block/tick; the FIRST crystal of a cycle also lights the centre x73 and then the column z65->69; the second only its own half. When both are placed in the same tick (the usual first cycle, two '1/2' lines at dt 166), all 16 light from both ends inward then down the column (dt 184-195). (2) all 16 turn back to coal_block, ends first then the column (~10 ticks), 57-58 ticks after Maxor's beam-hit line ('THAT BEAM! IT HURTS! IT HURTS!!' / 'YOU TRICKED ME!' / etc., whichever line follows the lamps), i.e. when the laser hit ends. Start = all coal_block.
p1lamps.consistency: 8/8 runs: first lit burst dt 183-185, first coal burst 262-264 (one run 273-283, 293 in a run where the beam line came at 236): always beam line + 57/58. Second cycle depends on when players place crystals.

pillars._doc: Storm crushers. Each is a rounded 7x7 pillar (37 columns, rows 3-5-7-7-7-5-3) of polished_diorite with diorite on the 4 edge-midpoint columns, hanging from the ceiling (y205; cobblestone walls / yellow terracotta trim at y197-200 around it are static scenery). Pillar origin = min corner (x,z). Below the bottom: air down to the floor (y168 terracotta pad colour).
pillars.restLayer: for y in [bottom..205]: every footprint column = minecraft:polished_diorite, except dioriteColumns = minecraft:diorite. Armed (bottom 186) = the same with y175-185 air.

yellowRestBlocks._doc: Yellow pillar (origin 43,62) full resting state from the library, y175-205, bottom at 175. Other pillars: same diorite layout; only the terracotta trim colour at y197-200 differs (Purple blue_terracotta, Yellow yellow_terracotta, Green lime_terracotta, Red red_terracotta), and Red hangs higher (origins.libBottom).

stepDown._doc: One step = bottom b -> b-1, every 4 server ticks, applied to all 37 columns in the same tick (recorded, Yellow, 2026-10-01_19-47-15, Storm +19..+42 and +759..+778). Order of writes within tick T per column, then T+3:
tickT: y=b -> minecraft:moving_piston[facing=west,type=normal] (only in steps that start from rest at 175; later steps leave y=b as moving_piston[facing=down])
tickT3: y=b-1 -> minecraft:polished_diorite (minecraft:diorite on dioriteColumns for the new bottom layer)
stepDown.netVisible: For 3 ticks the new bottom layer (and the old bottom) shows moving_piston (invisible, no collision); the pistons only exist inside one tick (never visible). So procedurally: at T set layer b-1 (and b) to moving_piston[facing=down,type=normal]; at T+3 set them to polished_diorite (diorite on the 4 edge columns of the bottom layer). Some server ticks split one step over 2 consecutive ticks (packet batching).

stepUp._doc: Retract (floor cycle: a pillar that reached the floor). The bottom layer turns to air (all 37 at once), one layer every 4 ticks (+-1), bottom-up (Yellow: y169 at Storm+67 ... y188 at +164). Then re-arm downwards with stepDown (pistons at y=b+1, moving pistons at b-1..b) from y189 to bottom 186 and below as the pad keeps it moving.

resetAfterCrush._doc: 20 ticks after the crush line (next 20-tick check) every layer below the pillar's armed/rest bottom turns to minecraft:air in one tick (all columns, all layers at once; e.g. Yellow y176-182 = 229 blocks at Storm+818). The pillar is spent afterwards.

p4.consistency: "Let's make some space!" is exactly 392 ticks after Necron's first line ("You went further than any human before, congratulations.") in 8/8 runs. Two parts: (a) a lava fall starts ~220 ticks before the line (-217..-225; ~170 after Necron's first line): a lava source column descends from y85 one block every ~10 ticks with flowing lava (level 2/10) around it, then spreads over y59-63 as lava sources/flow (vanilla fluid spreading, timing approximate). The column's x,z differs per run (82,48 here; 26,104 in 2026-10-01_20-05-47) - one of the corner pillars. (b) platform removal: ~160 positions go to air at once 45-57 ticks after the line (45 here). Frames are all changes at the 1551 cluster positions after Necron's first line in this run.
